summary: Iteration 115: retest of the iteration_114 fixes for direct bond purchase. Backend: new suite test_bond_direct_orders_iter115.py, 9/9 passed. Regression: iter111-113 (24 passed, 1 skipped) and iter114 (11/11 passed). The iter114 hard-coded expectations were updated to the new capped quote, which is now 38 pieces and 984.35. Frontend (Playwright, TEST customer + QA admin) passed: 409 re-quote, price meta, orders panel, admin bank-submit and execute, and the customer executed view. Verified fixed: (1) The rounding now matches. The quote, reservation, admin preview, ledger debit and execution total_amount are identical: 999.62 in the spec case, and 989.10 in the UI case after a 102 % price change. (2) Total cap: 39 pieces / 999.62 for fee 1 %, min 10. With a 2.5 fixed fee and 0.8 % accrued, 1000 → 38 pieces / 984.35, 1009.92 → 39 pieces, 1009.91 → 38 pieces. (3) The reject audit 'before' is awaiting_bank or bank_submitted as appropriate. (4) The execute response includes total_amount, gross_amount, accrued_interest, fees and bank_reference. (5) The price meta has no leading '·'. (6) BondBuyDialog on 409 shows the toast, stays open, re-fetches and shows the new summary (102,00 %, 969,00 €, 989,10 €). Re-confirming succeeds. (7) Direct orders are no longer rows in the Anleihen-Kaufanfragen table on desktop or mobile. Regression OK: parallel 201/402, insufficient 402 + IBP, cancel/reject releasing the reservation, idempotent execute (resumed, one debit), BANK_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, Rabobank still request-only. Not fully fixed: the IBP customer_name first/last-name branch never fires (see backend_issues).

minor.issue: The first/last-name preference never takes effect. get_current_user returns public_user(), which only has id, email, name, role, avatar_url and created_at, so user.get('first_name') is always None. Repro: a user with first_name 'TEST_UI', last_name 'Kunde' and name 'TEST_altname' gets IBP customer_name 'TEST_altname'. Only the users.name → email fallback works. Also, create_direct_order's customer_name_snapshot (bond_requests.py:374) still falls back straight to the email and skips users.name; the UI order snapshot was the email. Fix: load the users doc (db.users.find_one) in both places, or build one shared helper.

The audit entry 'executed' still hard-codes before={'status':'approved'} (bond_requests.py:732), but direct orders are executed from bank_submitted. On a resumed (idempotent) execute, a duplicate 'executed' audit row is also written.

The prior status is read in a separate find_one before the atomic update. In a rare race the audit 'before' could be stale. Acceptable, but returning the pre-image (ReturnDocument.BEFORE) would make it exact.

ui_bugs.issue: When a customer has only direct orders, hasBondRequests (bondPurchaseRequests.length) is still true. An empty table with only headers (DATUM/ANLEIHE/ISIN/VOLUMEN/STATUS/HINWEIS) and no rows or empty state renders above the 'Kaufaufträge aus dem Guthaben' panel. The KPI 'Anleihen-Anfragen' also counts direct orders. Fix: compute hasBondRequests from the filtered (non-direct) list and render the panel independently.

integration_issues.issue: After the 409 re-quote, the card behind the dialog still shows the old 'Verbindlicher Kaufkurs 101,50 %' until the page reloads. Consider refreshing the catalog on 409 or after ordering.

issues: The direct order row volume column shows the requested amount_eur (1.000 €), not the reserved total (989,10 €) or nominal (950). This can confuse admins.
The non-TEST seeded bond 'CRASH TEST PT_BOND_C3' (ISIN PT_BOND_C3) is visible to customers in the catalog. It is pre-existing data and was not created by this run. Consider hiding or removing it.
Bank confirmation date still uses a native <input type=date> (unchanged from iter114).

action_items: Fix the customer_name resolution: fetch the users doc (first_name + last_name → name → email) in record_advisory_request and in create_direct_order's customer_name_snapshot. The current user dict has no first/last name.
Execute audit: write before={'status': <actual prior status>} and skip the audit write when resumed=true.
OrdersPage: hide the empty 'Anleihen-Kaufanfragen' table when only direct orders exist, and exclude direct orders from the 'Anleihen-Anfragen' KPI (or count them separately).
Optional: refresh the catalog card after a 409 re-quote. Optional: show reserved/settled total in the admin row volume for direct orders.
critical_code_review_comments: The bond_order_service._money and bond_execution_service._q_money duplicates now both use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Better to import one helper so they cannot drift again.

The compute_quote cap loop is linear in pieces. Fine for the current amounts (the cap removes only a few pieces), but a large fixed fee with a tiny denomination could loop many times. Could compute it directly.
Saving any file under /app/backend (including tests/) triggers a uvicorn hot reload and briefly causes 502s. Tests that start right after an edit can fail at setup.

rca of the issue: IBP customer_name: routes use Depends(get_current_user), which returns public_user(doc) without first_name/last_name. record_advisory_request therefore always skips the first/last branch. Mitigation: query db.users by user['id'] inside the helper.
